newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices continue to ease.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices continue to ease.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to be further tested this week, based on the large offering, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly market preview.
A total of 110,700 bales will be offered at sales in Goulburn, Melbourne and Fremantle.

The eastern market indicator fell 13 cents to 598 cents a kg clean last week. Wesfarmers said fine wools would be most affected with the next four weeks of designated superfine/fine sales bringing large quantities of these to auction.
However, last week's relatively firm market close in Adelaide indicated that the broader end of the marked may have reached levels of buying support.

"Suggestions of new Chinese business, assisted by the continued fall of the A$ and the threat of less of these wool types being available over the next month, are expected to support these prices," Wesfarmers said.
Micron price differentials were expected to narrow with broad wool prices relatively stabilising and fine wool prices tending weaker.
